messages.content: 四個圓的總周長是多少，其中第一個圓的半徑為5公分，第二個圓的半徑為10公分，第三個圓的半徑為15公分，第四個圓的半徑為20公分？

function.name: calculate_circumference
function.description: Calculates the circumference of a circle with a given radius. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circle in the unit given.

message.content:
要計算每顆圓的周長，我們使用公式  

\[
C = 2 \pi r
\]

| 圓 | 半徑 \(r\)（cm） | 周長 \(C = 2\pi r\) |
|---|-----------------|---------------------|
| 第 1 顆 | 5   | \(2\pi\times5 = 10\pi \approx 31.42\,\text{cm}\) |
| 第 2 顆 | 10  | \(2\pi\times10 = 20\pi \approx 62.83\,\text{cm}\) |
| 第 3 顆 | 15  | \(2\pi\times15 = 30\pi \approx 94.25\,\text{cm}\) |
| 第 4 顆 | 20  | \(2\pi\times20 = 40\pi \approx 125.66\,\text{cm}\) |

將所有周長相加：

\[
\begin{aligned}
C_{\text{total}} &= 10\pi + 20\pi + 30\pi + 40\pi\\[4pt]
&= (10+20+30+40)\,\pi \\[4pt]
&= 100\pi \\
&\approx 314.16~\text{cm}.
\end{aligned}
\]

**答案：這四個圓的總周長約為 **\(314.16\;\text{厘米}\)**。

Circumference formula C=2πr. So:

C1 = 2 * π * 5 = 10π ≈ 31.4159 cm
C2 = 2*π*10 = 20π ≈ 62.8318 cm
C3 = 2*π*15 = 30π ≈94.2477 cm
C4 = 2*π*20 =40π≈125.6637 cm

Sum = (10+20+30+40)π =100π ≈314.159265 cm.
